verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model-serving runtime with a REST API, so outbound webhook subscriptions are a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The REST API, the OpenAPI spec and the OpenClaw messaging-app integrations (Slack/Discord) do not qualify as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
